events.factual_description: Jazz at Lincoln Center presents Cécile McLorin Salvant in Rose Theater on May 13-15, 2027 at 7:30 PM. JALC describes the engagement as an intimate quartet setting featuring her frequent collaborator Sullivan Fortner on piano, with a repertoire spanning reworked standards, original compositions, centuries-old songs and rarely performed material from the Great American Songbook. The three performances are part of Jazz at Lincoln Center's 2026-27 season.

en.why_it_matters: Salvant's voice works less like a fixed jazz-vocal style than an instrument for taking songs apart and rebuilding their emotional logic. Pairing her again with Sullivan Fortner puts the focus on phrasing, harmonic reaction and the strange repertoire choices that make her sets feel composed in real time rather than delivered from a standards book.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the three Rose Theater nights if a New York trip overlaps. The Salvant-Fortner partnership is a strong reason to build an evening around the concert, while three performances provide enough flexibility that it should not automatically displace a rarer one-off.

es.why_it_matters: La voz de Salvant funciona menos como un estilo fijo de jazz vocal que como un instrumento para desarmar canciones y reconstruir su lógica emocional. Volver a ponerla junto a Sullivan Fortner deja al frente el fraseo, la reacción armónica y esas elecciones raras de repertorio que hacen que sus sets parezcan componerse en tiempo real, no salir de un cancionero.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a una de las tres noches en Rose Theater si coincide con un viaje a Nueva York. La sociedad Salvant-Fortner es razón suficiente para construir una noche alrededor del concierto, mientras que tres funciones dan margen para no desplazar automáticamente un one-off más raro.

events.factual_description: Jazz at Lincoln Center presents Gerry Mulligan Centennial: Mulligan and Me in The Appel Room on June 4-5, 2027, with Friday sets at 7:00 PM and 9:00 PM and Saturday sets at 4:30 PM and 7:00 PM. The work is conceived by writer Iris Dart and directed by Rachel Dart as a play with music about Mulligan's creative partnership with actress and singer Judy Holliday in the 1960s. Ted Nash, a longtime Mulligan collaborator and protégé, serves as music director, and current JLCO baritone saxophonist Paul Nedzela is featured.

en.why_it_matters: The direct lineage is what makes this more than another centennial repertory night. Ted Nash worked with Mulligan and carries that language from inside the band, while Paul Nedzela puts a contemporary baritone voice next to it. Building the concert around Mulligan's creative relationship with Judy Holliday also opens a less familiar side of his history and turns the evening into a hybrid of live jazz, memory and theater rather than a museum-style tribute.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the four Appel Room sets if a New York trip overlaps, especially if baritone saxophone and living musical lineage are central to the listening thread. Four performances across two days provide enough access that it works as a strong trip anchor without demanding that every other plan move around it.

es.why_it_matters: El linaje directo es lo que vuelve esto algo más que otra noche de repertorio por centenario. Ted Nash trabajó con Mulligan y carga ese lenguaje desde dentro de la banda, mientras Paul Nedzela pone una voz contemporánea de saxo barítono frente a esa memoria. Construir el concierto alrededor de la relación creativa entre Mulligan y Judy Holliday abre además una zona menos conocida de su historia y convierte la noche en un híbrido de jazz en vivo, memoria y teatro, no en un tributo de museo.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los cuatro sets en The Appel Room si coincide con un viaje a Nueva York, sobre todo si el saxo barítono y el linaje musical vivo están en el centro del hilo de escucha. Cuatro funciones en dos días dan suficiente acceso para que sea una ancla fuerte del viaje sin obligar a mover todos los demás planes.
